title: Karl Popper & falsifiability
principle: A claim earns its status by being refutable. If nothing could show it to be wrong, it is not saying anything.

anchor.title: The Logic of Scientific Discovery
anchor.author: Karl Popper
anchor.note: First published in German as *Logik der Forschung* (1934). The anchor is the demarcation criterion rather than the whole philosophy of science.
